summary: Iteration 45: Tested Piket Gerbang + Face Recognition backend (22 pytest tests, 21 pass / 1 fail) and smoke-tested new UI (/piket, /face-attendance, /face-enroll, /classes/<id>). All data-testid hooks requested are present; piket CRUD, conflicts, role guard, guru check-in/out all work; face enroll min3/invalid-length/inconsistent/success/duplicate/scan/unenroll all work. 1 backend bug: /api/attendance/face-scan returns 500 (IndexError) instead of 404 when descriptor is very far from enrolled samples (dist > 9).

critical.issue: 500 IndexError when scan descriptor is far from any enrolled face (e.g. [1.0]*128). In server.py _face_best(), sentinel value 9 in `best.get(sid, 9)` is too small; large distances never populate `best` dict, so `ranked[0]` raises IndexError. Fix: use `float('inf')` sentinel (or any value > sqrt(128)=11.31). Expected behaviour: `dist > FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD(0.5)` -> HTTP 404 'Wajah tidak dikenali'.

issues: Clock widget appears mirrored/reversed inside the live camera panel in the screenshot - looks like the camera canvas is overlaid in a mirrored state over the clock text; verify CSS transform scaleX on video doesn't also flip overlay time text.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file test_iter45_piket_face.py covers all piket + face endpoints. The single failing test (TestFace.test_09_face_scan_unknown) documents the real backend bug: fix the sentinel in _face_best and the test will pass. Headless browsers DO support getUserMedia in Chromium automation, so face-attendance camera actually went live during smoke (no camera-error path hit); to force that path would require blocking mediaDevices.
rca of the issue: RCA for face-scan 500: In _face_best(), after computing distances, each sid is kept only if dd < best.get(sid, 9). The literal `9` acts as an initial comparison baseline. For normal faces distances are < 1, so this works. But when the probe descriptor is extremely different (e.g. all 1.0s giving Euclidean distance ~11.31 from a near-zero stored descriptor), every dd >= 9 so no sid ever gets inserted, leaving `best` empty. Then `ranked = sorted(best.items())` is `[]` and `ranked[0]` raises IndexError, surfaced as HTTP 500. Repro: enroll any face then POST /api/attendance/face-scan with descriptor=[1.0]*128. Mitigation: replace 9 with float('inf').
